test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some deer are snakes.

All deer are tigers.

Some wolves are deer.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some tigers are not deer.

II. Some deer are wolves.

III. Some tigers are snakes.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow
Only conclusions I and III follow

solution:
Given Statements:

Some deer are snakes.

All deer are tigers.

Some wolves are deer.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/becda5baee99627c2dacbdbe72ff2f21be3ebfce452f35757751dd75c9970467.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some tigers are not deer - False (Because, All deer are tigers gives some tigers are deer, and the remaining part can be possible only).

II. Some deer are wolves - True (Because, Some wolves are deer gives Some deer are wolves).

III. Some tigers are snakes - True (Because, Those part of Tigers which is Deer is Snakes).

So, Only conclusions II and III follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
